claim: During the 2005 Palm Beach Police search of Jeffrey Epstein's residence at 358 El Brillo Way, detectives found and disabled two covert cameras concealed inside clocks — one in a wall clock in the garage, the other "within a desk clock beside Epstein's desk" — and located a computer believed to hold the images they recorded. Investigators recorded that the hidden cameras sat "alongside a girl's high school transcript." Separately, a witness statement in the House Oversight estate release alleges that "Mr Epstein's residences in Florida and New York had surveillance cameras that taped the sex sessions" and even the bathroom; another estate document records a contrary account that there were "never any hidden cameras anywhere besides the garage and the camera in the living room focused on the place where money was kept." The covert cameras themselves are a documented police-search finding; what they recorded is contested across the witness statements.

notes: Primary docs read verbatim from local corpus. Spine = the documented 2005 Palm Beach PD finding of covert clock-cameras (hard fact, physically recovered). The 'taped the sex sessions / bathroom' line (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_023035) is an attributed witness-statement ALLEGATION, presented as such, not asserted; the same doc carries explicit victim-adjacent and third-party (Barak) allegations that are NOT quoted here per PII discipline.
